Leaflet 1.9.4 (BSD-2-Clause, see vendor/leaflet/LICENSE) and protomaps-leaflet (BSD-3-Clause, see vendor/protomaps/LICENSE) are copied from the Course Atlas site, which vendors them. protomaps-leaflet.js had its ES-module wrapper line removed so it loads as a classic script (global protomapsL). Map tiles: OpenFreeMap / OpenMapTiles / OpenStreetMap contributors (attribution is shown on the map).
